source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. I am struggling with acne. Please suggest a treatment.
=========================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. G. S. S. Sandeep**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jul 17, 2017 and last reviewed on: Jul 11, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I have been struggling with acne for a while now and have been postponing going to my general physician. I have been very hesitant on what to use and do not ever apply anything apart from a light cleanser on my face. I am not even sure what the term would be for it except the loose term rosacea. I am looking for advice on what prescription or non-prescription medication would be safe and effective for my acne with concerns of my nose getting worse. I also have very pale skin.

【9】Answered by Dr. G. S. S. Sandeep

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Your concern is acne rosacea and sensitive, acne-prone skin. You should avoid the following:

【14】1.  Direct exposure to sunlight between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM.
2.  Foods like chocolate and alcohol.
3.  Oily and spicy food.
4.  Cold items.
5.  Getting too emotional.

【15】Use Cetaphil DAM moisturizer and Ansolar 75 SPF sunscreen. For acne, you can apply Epiduo gel (a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide) on moisturized skin at bedtime. Take vitamin A rich foods like carrots and papaya.

【16】Patient's Query

【17】Hello doctor,

【18】Thanks for the reply. I went to see my GP and she said that a Metronidazole cream prescription could help reduce my rosacea. Would that be a correct statement? And what would be the best option if that is not? I think my rosacea is triggered by stress. I have ADHD and major depressive disorder.

【19】Answered by Dr. G. S. S. Sandeep

【20】#

【21】Hello,

【22】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【23】Rosacea can be handled through systemic and topical medications.

【24】1.  Systemic medications like oral Tetracycline, oral Metronidazole, oral retinoids, and Dapsone.
2.  Topical medications like Metronidazole gel, Benzoyl peroxide gel, Tretinoin cream, Clindamycin gel, Tacrolimus, and Topical Ivermectin.

【25】You just require perseverance to observe the precautions I mentioned earlier. Do not worry. You will be alright.

【26】* * *

source_info.title: How to improve vision with eye floaters?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. How to improve vision with eye floaters?
===========================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Anand Yattinamani**

【4】and medically reviewed by Dr. Vinodhini. J

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jan 09, 2020 and last reviewed on: Jul 25, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】My grandmother is 65 years old. She has a problem with eye flashes for four years. She complaints of getting lights in her eyes in various shapes like stars, sparks, and pictures of various colors. She is left with only 5% eyesight. Please recommend the best medicine and eye drops for this problem of eye flashes. She is currently using ayurvedic eye drops. She underwent laser treatment.

【9】Answered by Dr. Anand Yattinamani

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Flashes are usually due to retinal problems like retinal tears , or detachment. Floaters in diabetics can be due to blood in the vitreous. These have to be treated with lasers, retinal surgeries and/or intravitreal Avastin injections. As she is left with only 5% of vision these are the only options. Strict control of diabetes is a must. Please give the history of any eye surgeries, past eye treatments, present vision in both eyes. Kindly send pictures of old records for more details.

【14】Patient's Query

【15】Thank you doctor,

【16】My grandmother had laser treatment three years before, but after the laser treatment flashes increased. Doctors said there is no eye drops for eye flashes. Please tell the best eye drop for eye flashes even if any eye drop is available in other countries I will get it through the order. My grandmother says that if flashes of light are removed then she will be able to see clearly. Please help.

【17】Answered by Dr. Anand Yattinamani

【18】#

【19】Hi,

【20】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【21】It is true that there is no treatment for flashes. Possible causes have to be treated. Person affected should learn to ignore these flashes, this will slowly get better with time. Please share the pictures of old records.

【22】* * *

source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. How to overcome behavioral anger and detachment issues?
==========================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Vishal Anilkumar Gandhi**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jul 12, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I want to consult regarding my behavior and mental health problem. I have noticed in my behavior that I easily get irritated and angry at everything. I cannot control my emotions sometimes. When there are no school days, I have been sleeping all day, then I stay up all night. I am also experiencing rarely eating anything, but sometimes, I eat a lot and then felt guilty after eating. Every time that I wanted to open up about my problems to anyone, I already think that they will judge and invalidate my feelings, then I ended up not opening up to them. Sometimes, when I am in a crowded place or any place that has people, I always stutter and my heart is pounding hard. I also do not have energy always when it comes to doing a simple task. Everything feels like it is hard for me to do. Every time I felt these, I feel like I want to seek help. Can you help me?

【9】Answered by Dr. Vishal Anilkumar Gandhi

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】I read your query and understand your concern. You may have a major depressive disorder. There is non-pharmacological management for your depression, you should try to follow the below guidelines to deal with it. It will help you.

【14】1\. Try doing exercises daily for 30 to 45 minutes like at least going for a walk. it will uplift your mood and build confidence.

【15】2\. Do meditation for 20 minutes daily, just sit in one place in a comfortable position and try to concentrate on your normal breathing, do not stop or force yourself to stop your thoughts, just let it be. it will reduce your irritability and calm you.

【16】3\. Try eating healthy home-cooked foods, and avoid junk foods.

【17】4\. Drink enough water.

【18】5\. Spend quality time with friends and family daily or do video calls if you are living away from your family.

【19】6\. Spend time on creative hobbies like reading good books, writing journals, painting, drawing, and learning new skills or language or musical instruments.

【20】7\. Take enough seven to eight hours of sleep daily. fix your time for sleep. Do not sleep in the daytime.

【21】8\. Avoid tobacco or alcohol or any substance abuse.

【22】9\. Live your life, do not just spend it.

【23】10\. Be bold and confident.

【24】If you still have symptoms that persist after following the advice for four to six weeks, then you need to start medications for a short duration. I hope I have cleared all your doubts.

【25】Thank you.

【26】* * *

source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Could a delay in the second period after taking the i-Pill post-unprotected sex mean pregnancy?
==================================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Balakrishnan R**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jul 11, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I had unprotected sex and took the i-Pill within three to four hours. I got my periods on time but it lasted only for three days and the color was brown and not the regular red. But the flow was normal. Now the second period is delayed by two days but I am having abdominal pain and cramps. I took the pregnancy test last month after a week after taking i-Pill and it was negative. Just the second period is getting delayed. What might be the reason? Am I pregnant?

【9】Thank you.

【10】Answered by Dr. Balakrishnan R

【11】#

【12】Hello,

【13】Welcome to icliniq.co m.

【14】I read your query and understand your concern.

【15】For a young lady of 22 years, a delay in periods of up to seven days is normal. i-Pill is a high dose of Progesterone hormone that is produced in the body in the second half of the period after ovulation. This pill will suddenly increase the thickness of the inner lining of the uterus, making it unfavorable for a possible pregnancy to sit. As it is a single dose, it has no strength to stand on, so it falls off and you get period or bleeding of the increased thickness within 7 to 10 days. Usually, this pill can slightly disturb the normal hormonal balance and hence your periods. The cramping sensation is just a feature of impending periods. Once you have had your period and the urine test is negative, there is no chance of pregnancy. As I see in the history, you are just above the normal weight range. Your expected weight is in the range of 114 to 121 lbs. Once you reduce weight to the normal range, you would not need any medicine to get periods. To reduce weight:

【16】1.  No fasting.
2.  No junk food or fast foods or red meat.
3.  Stop snacks in between meals.
4.  Have low calories food with high proteins.
5.  Regular exercise (especially for the waist and hip area). Aerobics, yoga, and brisk walking (swing your hands well).
6.  Try to reduce four to six pounds per month. Do not hurry on weight reduction, it will be difficult to maintain. As soon as you reduce at least 11 lbs, you will see changes. Even if you are in the normal weight range, try this schedule, it will help. For a person with borderline weight, when a hormone in the form of i-Pill is taken, the balance of hormones is tipped and periods will be disturbed like this.

【17】So if I may advise you:

【18】1.  If frequent sex is expected, having a regular cyclical birth control pill, will regularize the cycle and give almost 100 % contraception.
2.  If sex is going to be infrequent, then use condoms.

【19】Thank you for choosing icliniq.

【20】I am happy to help you and will always be available whenever you need me at icliniq.com.

【21】* * *

source_info.title: Why is Naproxen not working for my headache?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Why is Naproxen not working for my headache?
===============================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. J. Mariano Anto Bruno Mascarenhas**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jun 25, 2016 and last reviewed on: Jul 28, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】I am suffering from unilateral headache for the last two months. I had an eye examination and that was fine. My blood tests were all normal. I have seen three doctors, my general practitioner (GP) and two hospital doctors, who all say it is likely a benign headache or tension-type headache of some description. I have no other symptoms other than the pain. I was prescribed Naproxen 500 mg twice daily which helped for two weeks. Pain came back a week after stopping Naproxen, but more mild than before. Then went away for five days and returned. Now, Naproxen does not seem to help at all. Doctors have not been concerned enough to give me a scan, because I have no other symptoms and just the pain. Again, this has been going on for two months now and even on pain-free days while on naproxen I have still had brief one second flashes of pain at least a couple of times a day. I have no sickness or nausea or dizziness. I do not have a history of migraine.There is no pain behind my eye or tearing. I also have no anxiety or tension issues in my personal life to attribute to a headache. The pain is in my left temporal area. I feel some pressure, pinching pain and tightness. Sometimes, it is in the inner ear and sometimes I have pain on the top left of my head. Before I started the Naproxen, it was at its worst at bedtime when I laid down, but I slept pain free for a month while on the Naproxen. The pain is quite mild, but persistent. So, it is very annoying and always on my mind now that the Naproxen does not seem to work at all and I cannot rely on it for relief. Why would naproxen suddenly stop working? Should I be concerned that I have a sinister condition?

【9】Answered by Dr. J. Mariano Anto Bruno Mascarenhas

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com. Naproxen is no longer helping because the enzymes in your liver has learnt to degrade the drug quickly. It usually happens when you take such drugs for a longer time. Since there is no vomiting, you can wait till your next scheduled visit. If there is vomiting, then you have to go emergency room immediately and do the following on emergency basis. 1. Fundus examination. 2. MRI brain. 3. EEG (electroencephalography).

【13】* * *

source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. After switching to insulin injection, my dad gets stomach pain and swollen feet. Why?
========================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Nadeem Abootty**

【4】and medically reviewed by Dr. Vinodhini. J

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Apr 24, 2020 and last reviewed on: Jul 12, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】My dad has type 2 diabetes. He is on insulin 14 mg a day and twice on some days. He has been having severe stomach pain for weeks and now he has lost a lot of weight. Since being on insulin his feet have become swollen, and his eyes yellow. Prior to insulin, he was on Metformin but his blood sugar was still high. Now he is suffering more, I really do not know what to do now. Please help. Should he go back to Metformin?

【9】Answered by Dr. Nadeem Abootty

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】From your history, it seems your father is suffering from uncontrolled Diabetes mellitus for seven months or more which was not controlled with Metformin. The present complaints you have mentioned after starting insulin, may not be actually related to insulin rather may be due to uncontrolled diabetes or else a systemic disease most probably involving liver in view of jaundice. Or even a renal problem can cause the same because he is on pain killers (Ibuprofen) which may effects negatively to kidneys in such patients. First, stop Ibuprofen at the earliest. Make sure insulin is injected at proper site, rule out insulin site infections. Rule out kidney and liver involvement by doing RFT (renal function test) and LFT (liver function test) along with blood routine. Why insulin was directly started after Metformin is also a doubt? There are many good oral tablets which are stronger than Metformin that may be tried before insulin if no contraindications.

【14】* * *

【15】**The Probable causes:**  

【16】Weight loss may be due to uncontrolled sugars which are signified by blood sugars postmeal.

【17】**Investigations to be done:**  

【18】Do liver function test, renal function test, complete blood count with ESR (erythrocyte sedimentation rate) and HBA1c (glycated hemoglobin).

【19】**Treatment plan:**  

【20】Take proper diabetic diet. Do regular aerobic exercises for 30 minutes per day. Insulin maybe continued- have special care on storage, site of injection, methods of injecting. It can be shifted to anti-diabetic tablets once the patient is stable.

【21】* * *

source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Am I under the right treatment for cough?
============================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Naresh Kumar M.**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jul 20, 2016 and last reviewed on: Jun 03, 2020_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】I am having cough for two to three weeks now. It is mostly dry and frequent throughout the day. I am getting two to three coughs at one time and then it continues. Currently, I am taking Piriton-CS, Pantocid and Montek-LC. I had bronchitis problem a few years back wherein I used to get frequent cough. Please help.

【9】Answered by Dr. Naresh Kumar M.

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】I had gone through all the details you have posted.

【14】*   The **medications you are taking are good** , but as you were saying that you continue to have dry cough since three weeks some changes need to be done.

【15】*   Avoid cool drinks or cool water. Do gargles with Listerine or Chlorhexidine mouthwash two times a day and avoid dust.

【16】*   Continue the same syrup three times a day. Also, I suggest syrup Corex ( **combination of Chlorpheniramine maleate and Codeine** ) as it is a more powerful cough suppressant.

【17】*   I suggest a course of antibiotic, tablet Azee 500 mg (Azithromycin) one tablet in the morning for three days and capsule Benz pearls ( **Benzonatate** ) three times daily for four days.

【18】*   Continue Montek-LC (combination of Montelukast and Levocetirizine) once daily at night.

【19】*   Avoid smoking or alcohol, if you have the habit.

【20】For further information consult an **internal medicine physician online** \--> https://www.icliniq.com/ask-a-doctor-online/internal-medicine-physician

【21】* * *

source_info.title: My father is having persistent fever for five days with COVID-19 symptoms. Kindly help.
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. My father is having persistent fever for five days with COVID-19 symptoms. Kindly help.
==========================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. N. Ashok Viswanath**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on May 11, 2021 and last reviewed on: Jul 17, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】My father is a 61-year-old, and he started having symptoms of COVID-19 before nine days. His blood reports and HRCT report (4/25) before three days came normal. The only major problem is that he is having fever for the past five days (average 101 degrees Fahrenheit), his oxygen level is around 96 %, and he does not suffer from any known morbidity. Can you please tell me how to reduce his fever?

【9】Answered by Dr. N. Ashok Viswanath

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Before proceeding to the treatment, I would like to know few details:

【14】1.  Is the oxygen saturation dropping from 98 or 99 to 96?
2.  Is he having any other symptoms like loss of smell or taste, cough, or breathlessness?

【15】Kindly get back to me with the above-asked details so that I can help you with your problem.

【16】Patient's Query

【17】Hello doctor,

【18】Thank you for the reply. His oxygen saturation is stable at 96 and is not fluctuating. Other than fever, the only symptom he has is cough, but it is rare. It is only present for a short duration in the morning when he wakes up. He does not have any other symptoms. Please convey with regards to the fever.

【19】Answered by Dr. N. Ashok Viswanath

【20】#

【21】Hello,

【22】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【23】Do not worry, and do not panic. Your father will be alright soon. Based on the symptoms, it is a respiratory infection due to some microbial etiology, which may also be due to COVID-19 (as we are in a COVID pandemic, we can not miss it). Kindly follow my advice:

【24】1.  Measure the body temperature and SpO2 once in six hours.
2.  Keep your father in a positive and motivating ambience.
3.  Good bed rest is mandatory now.
4.  Tablet Azithromycin 500 mg one tablet in the morning after food for five days.
5.  Tablet Combiflam (Ibuprofen 400 mg and Paracetamol 325 mg) one tablet in the morning, afternoon, and night after food for five days. (If your father is allergic to Ibuprofen, he can take tablet Paracetamol 650 mg instead of tablet Combiflam)
6.  Tablet Montek LC 10 mg (Levocetirizine 5 mg and Montelukast 10 mg) one tablet in the morning and night after food for days.
7.  Tablet Limcee 500 (Vitamin C) one tablet in the morning after food (chewable) for five days.
8.  Tablet Nurokind D3 (Mecobalamin, Alpa lipoic acid, Vitamin D3, Pyridoxine hydrochloride, and Folic acid) one tablet in the afternoon after food for five days.
9.  Syrup Ascoril LS (Ambroxol 30 mg/5 ml, Levosalbutamol 1 mg/5 ml, Guaifenesin 50 mg/ 5 ml) 5ml in the morning, afternoon, evening, and night for five days.
10.  Tablet Pan 40 (Pantoprazole) one tablet in the morning, 30 minutes before food for five days.
11.  Alex or Tusq-D (Amylmetacresol 0.5 mg, Dextromethorphan, Hydrobromide 5mg) lozenges. Sip five to six lozenges per day.
12.  Keep tablet Dexamethasone 2 mg and Budecort 200 inhaler (Budesonide 200 mcg) ready to use if SpO2 becomes less than 90. (Do not use these two if SpO2 is above 90)
13.  Give him food rich in Vitamin A, Vitamin C, Vitamin B12, and Vitamin D3. Include protein-rich food like egg, milk, dhal. Include flavonoids containing food like green tea. Give milk with turmeric, crushed pepper, and crushed ginger twice a day. All this food will help our body and immune system to recover from infections.
14.  Measure the SpO2 even in the nighttime and while your father is sleeping. If it drops, make him sit and lean forward.

【25】Breathing exercise four times a day.

【26】Exercise 1 - Pursed lip breathing - Deep inhale through the nose and keep the mouth in the pouting position and exhale out slowly. Repeat the cycle for few times.

【27】Exercise 2 - Buy a respirometer and use it. You need to inhale through the mouth part provided in the respirometer and inhale, such that the balls inside the respirometer will raise one by one.

【28】Exercise 3 - Breath-holding exercise - Inhale for three seconds, hold the breath for four seconds and exhale for five seconds.

【29】Give frequent warm water sips and keep him hydrated, and do not get stressed up. Your father will recover soon. Take care.

【30】* * *

【31】**Preventive measures:**  

【32】Personal protective measures while handling your dad.

【33】* * *

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.</mark>

【13】Before proceeding to the treatment, I would like to know few details:

【14】1.  Is the oxygen saturation dropping from 98 or 99 to 96?

【15】Kindly get back to me with the above-asked details so that I can help you with your problem.

7.  Tablet Limcee 500 (Vitamin C) one tablet in the morning after food (chewable) for five days.
8.  Tablet Nurokind D3 (Mecobalamin, Alpa lipoic acid, Vitamin D3, Pyridoxine hydrochloride, and Folic acid) one tablet in the afternoon after food for five days.
9.  Syrup Ascoril LS (Ambroxol 30 mg/5 ml, Levosalbutamol 1 mg/5 ml, Guaifenesin 50 mg/ 5 ml) 5ml in the morning, afternoon, evening, and night for five days.
10.  Tablet Pan 40 (Pantoprazole) one tablet in the morning, 30 minutes before food for five days.
11.  Alex or Tusq-D (Amylmetacresol 0.5 mg, Dextromethorphan, Hydrobromide 5mg) lozenges. Sip five to six lozenges per day.

【0】My 2.5 months pregnant wife's TSH has reduced. Do we need to reduce Thyronorm dosage?
Listen

【1】Q. My 2. 5 months pregnant wife's TSH has reduced. Do we need to reduce Thyronorm dosage?
=========================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Dattaprasad Balasaheb Inamdar**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jul 06, 2017 and last reviewed on: Jul 17, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】My wife is 2.5 months pregnant. She is 29 years old, weighs 101.8 lbs and is 4.10 feet tall. She has subclinical hypothyroidism, and her TSH is 12.7. She takes Thyronorm 75 mcg. Recently, we tested her TSH, which was 10.5 and total thyroxine (T4) is 12.4 (reference value is 4.5 to 12). Do we continue the same Thyronorm 75 mcg or reduce the dose?

【9】Answered by Dr. Dattaprasad Balasaheb Inamdar

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】What dose was she taking Thyronorm (Levothyroxine) before? When was the dosage altered last? If the dosage was not reduced recently, that is, in the last 2 to 3 months, then the dose can be reduced to 62.5 mcg daily. Repeat testing would be needed after 4 to 8 weeks of changing the dose.

【14】Patient's Query

【15】Hello doctor,

【16】Thank you for replying. Her **TSH was 12.7 three months back** , so the doctor prescribed Thyronorm 25 mcg. We did not check her TSH levels after that. When the pregnancy test came positive, we did a complete blood test. In that her TSH was 10.5. Please help.

【17】Answered by Dr. Dattaprasad Balasaheb Inamdar

【18】#

【19】Hi,

【20】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【21】*   **It is too early to change the dose** . Besides, TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone) is in the normal range. Free T4 would have more weight for changing dose rather than total T4. She can just continue the same dose and retest (free T4 and TSH) just before next scheduled visit to the doctor.

【22】*   If again free T4 is higher than normal and TSH goes down out of range, the dose can be reduced. Taking a little higher dose of Thyronorm will not harm, but **lower than required dose can harm the baby** . So please continue the same dose and repeat free T4 and TSH next time for dose adjustment.

【23】For further queries consult an **obstetrician and gynaecologist online** \--> https://www.icliniq.com/ask-a-doctor-online/obstetrician-and-gynaecologist

【24】* * *

source_info.text:
【0】Listen

source_info.title: I am having urinary bladder distention with bladder wall thickening. Will Levofloxacin help me?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. I am having urinary bladder distention with bladder wall thickening. Will Levofloxacin help me?
==================================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Khant Shahil Ramesh Bhai**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Oct 20, 2019 and last reviewed on: Jul 20, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I am a 59 years old male. I am suffering from urinary bladder distension with a bladder wall thickening of about 6 mm. My doctor advised me to take Levofloxacin. I would like to know whether it is the correct medicine to cure my problem. Further, I am having cryptorchidism (both undescended testes). My ignorant parents did not correct it during my childhood, and I would like to know its present risk. Also, I have hypertension associated with hypercholesterolemia and hypertriglyceridemia. I am taking Cilnidipine 10 mg, Rosuvastatin 10 mg, Fenofibrate 150 mg and Clopidogrel 75 mg. I have hepatomegaly also. Please suggest me better alternatives.

【9】Answered by Dr. Khant Shahil Ramesh Bhai

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Do you have any urinary problems like straining, poor flow, etc.? First, about your bladder distension with bladder wall thickening. This might indicate an infection in your bladder called Cystitis. If you do not have any symptoms or problem, then it is better to get urine routine and urine cultural and sensitivity test. If the infection is present on the above reports, then only you require antibiotics (Levofloxacin), otherwise no need. Regarding your undescended testes, it is of bit concern. Where is it? Is it palpable just above your scrotum or not palpable at all? But undescended testes does carry a risk of malignancy or torsion. Doing surgery to keep the testes in the scrotum will not reduce the chances of complications like malignancy, but it will help to monitor your testes. So incase if any of the complication arises it will be identified early and treated accordingly. If the size of your testes is small, then it is better to remove it, as small testes means it is atrophic and not working with no hormone secretion. You should also do serum testosterone at 8 am. This is to check whether your testes is functioning or not.

【14】I hope this helps.

【15】* * *

source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Why am I having ulcers that come and go in different sites inside mouth?
===========================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Mohammed Osama Aboborda**

【4】and medically reviewed by Dr. Divya Banu M

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Aug 15, 2019 and last reviewed on: Jul 20, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I have something in my mouth on my tongue. Sometimes it is inside my cheeks as well. It comes and goes in different spots.

【9】Answered by Dr. Mohammed Osama Aboborda

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Mostly these things are fungal ulcers. Repeated attacks means low immunity which appears after emotional and psychological stress. Are these ulcers painful or tender for foods and drinks? Do you have reflux? Do you have psychological stress? Anyway until answering my questions you can use Nystatin oral drops with oral antifungal gel.

【14】Patient's Query

【15】Thank you doctor,

【16】They do not hurt at all. I cannot even feel them. I looked at pictures of the geographical tongue and thought maybe that was what they are. They move and change in shape all the time. I was just scared it was cancer or something. I might have some reflux issues from time to time. I have a very dry mouth. I have always thought that was from medicines.

【17】Answered by Dr. Mohammed Osama Aboborda

【18】#

【19】Hi,

【20】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【21】Reflux is the main cause. You have to avoid spicy and fast foods. You can try anti-acid drugs as Omeprazole which is taken once daily before breakfast. As these things are not painful so these are not a fungal ulcer. Mostly, can be a geographical tongue. But these are not cancer at all. Malignant tongue ulcers have different character and shape. Malignant ulcers are fixed in its site and do not change the site at all. Do not panic. These are not carcinogenic at all.

【22】* * *

source_info.title: My mother's chest pain increases while sleeping. Is there any problem or just gastric pain?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. My mother's chest pain increases while sleeping. Is there any problem or just gastric pain?
==============================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Sagar Ramesh Makode**

【4】and medically reviewed by Dr. K Shobana

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Aug 29, 2021 and last reviewed on: Jul 13, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】My mother is having chest pain. And the pain increases while sleeping. I have attached her ECG report. Could you please tell is there any problem or it is because of gastritis? Thanks.

【9】Answered by Dr. Sagar Ramesh Makode

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Her ECG (electrocardiogram) is normal ( _attachments removed to protect the patient’s identity)._ Based on her symptoms, it is unlikely to be a cardiac pain. Cardiac pain or cardiac heaviness typically occurs on exertion and relieves with rest. Sometimes one can have breathlessness on exertion instead of chest pain. Pain that worsens on lying down is usually related to gastric reflux. I suggest her take an antacid like capsule Cyra-D (Rabeprazole and Domperidone) once daily before breakfast for five days. If there is a response, it is related to gastric reflux. She should avoid oily, spicy meals, have light meals, and walk after meals rather than rest immediately. Now, suppose she has symptoms after exertion, a family history of heart disease, or other risk factors. In that case, it is advisable to do an ECHO (echocardiogram), and if ECHO is normal, do a TMT (treadmill test) to rule out the cause for the pain. As ECG may not show any abnormalities in the early stages, it is recommended to do an ECHO and TMT as a screening investigation. I hope this helps you. Thanks.

【14】* * *

source_info.title: Why do I feel that my heart is squeezing and has skipped a beat?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Why do I feel that my heart is squeezing and has skipped a beat?
===================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Isaac Gana**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Dec 24, 2021 and last reviewed on: Jul 18, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】I have a feeling that I have skipped my heartbeats, and my heart is squeezing. It has been there on and off for years, and it is more frequent now. I am not taking any medications. Kindly help.

【9】Answered by Dr. Isaac Gana

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】I can understand your concern. You have PAC (premature atrial contractions). These are harmless and do not pose a threat. However, do you ever experience shortness of breath or dizziness ? Do you have any history of fainting? Have you ever been diagnosed with any heart disease?

【14】Patient's Query

【15】Hi doctor,

【16】I have not been diagnosed with any heart diseases and have had a stress test that did not show anything. Is there anything that would cause these PACs?

【17】Answered by Dr. Isaac Gana

【18】#

【19】Hello,

【20】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【21】The majority of the time, PACs are benign and do not pose any threat. Sometimes it can be caused by underlying heart diseases, and based on your description, it is most likely not due to heart disease. In only a few does it proceed to serious arrhythmias like atrial fibrillation. If your episodes become too rapid and disturbing, I will suggest medication. Best regards.

【22】* * *

source_info.title: Why does my right lower lobe look collpased and the whole right segment very large in the bronchoscopic picture?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Why does my right lower lobe look collpased and the whole right segment very large in the bronchoscopic picture?
===================================================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Muhammad Zubayer Alam**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Mar 17, 2022 and last reviewed on: Jul 18, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I want to ask if the bronchoscopy looks normal. The right lower lobe looks collpased and the right segment looks very large. I have wheezing, cough, and no sputum. I am very concerned that I have bronchiectasis.

【9】Answered by Dr. Muhammad Zubayer Alam

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com. According to your statement, you have a complaint of wheezing, and cough. According to your picture of bronchoscopy **( _attachment removed to protect the patient's identity_ )** , it seems to be normal. For confirmation, I advise you to get CXR (chest X-ray) or HRCT (high resolution computed tomography) of chest should be done and correlated with the picture of bronchoscopy. Usually, the bronchoscopic picture may show occlusion of the right main bronchus with only a pin-sized opening in case of right lung collapse. But in your picture of bronchoscopy, opening is larger than the size of a pin, so bronchoscopy result may be normal. A CXR or HRCT of chest maybe needed to exclude other causes.

【13】* * *

source_info.title: What could be the reason for missed periods during consecutive months?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. What could be the reason for missed periods during consecutive months?
=========================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Uzma Arqam**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on May 18, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I did not get my period for one month and now I am three days late for my period of this month. Am I overstressing?

【9】Kindly help.

【10】Answered by Dr. Uzma Arqam

【11】#

【12】Hello,

【13】Welcome to iciniq.com.

【14】Thank you for your query.

【15】I understand your concern. Stress , anxiety, overwork, strict diet, strenuous exercise, hormonal imbalance, contraceptives, and medications can disturb cycles.

【16】1.  You need to have a healthy lifestyle and exercise daily for maintaining a normal BMI and weight.
2.  Have a complete check-up and treatment of any health issue you have.
3.  Have nice recreational activities and try to get rid of recreational drugs if you have been taking them.
4.  Have healthy food with less salt, sugar, salt, and spice.
5.  Have one transvaginal scan, on day 2 of the period and blood test (serum progesterone, serum prolactin, serum insulin, serum testosterone, thyroid function test, FSH, and LH).
6.  For menstrual induction, if serum beta hCG comes negative then have a tablet of Primolut-N 10 mg twice daily for 5 days and wait for 1 to 2 weeks for withdrawal bleeding.
7.  You can have combined oral contraceptive pills for three months to regulate cycles.

【17】I hope this has helped you. Thank you.

【18】* * *

source_info.title: What is the treatment for the persistent ulcer present at the tip of tongue?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. What is the treatment for the persistent ulcer present at the tip of tongue?
===============================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Suneetha B S**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Nov 30, 2022 and last reviewed on: Jul 05, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】I have had a small mouth ulcer at the tip of my tongue for the last six days, and I am not getting cured. So I am taking due precautions like very soft food with curd, fruits with vitamin B complex, and multivitamin tablets. But the ulcer is not getting cured.

【9】Please suggest some antibiotics to cure the same, so I can recover quickly.

【10】Answered by Dr. Suneetha B S

【11】#

【12】Hello,

【13】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【14】I understand your concern.

【15】Mouth ulcers can be painful. However, taking antibiotics for this condition is not a good idea. Since you have just one ulcer, an antibiotic is not indicated for your condition.

【16】I suggest you some tips to help relieve your condition quickly. Please continue taking the multivitamin tablets for two weeks. In the meantime, avoid all spicy food and tea or coffee. Dehydration could cause mouth ulcers, so drink at least two to three liters of water a day. Stress or lack of sleep can cause mouth ulcers. So check if you get seven to eight hours of quality sleep daily.

【17】Apart from this, I suggest you to apply Lignocaine hydrochloride gel on the ulcer for 10 minutes before you eat anything. This will help relieve your pain to a great extent.

【18】However, please consult a specialist doctor, discuss with them and start taking the medications with their consent.

【19】Lastly, if you have gastritis irritation or acidity, that could be another reason for mouth ulcers . So avoid spicy food, tea, and coffee.

【20】I hope that helps.

【21】* * *

source_info.title: Am I taking my birth control pills in the right sequence?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Am I taking my birth control pills in the right sequence?
============================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Sravanthi Nuthalapati**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Sep 13, 2017 and last reviewed on: Jul 18, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I am a 28 year old female. I am on birth control pills (Femilon) from the last two months. I had finished the first pack on the 19th last month. After that, I got my period on the sixth pill-free day, that is, on the 25th. I have restarted the new pack on the 27th. I have taken all the pills regularly and at the same time between 10.30 to 11 PM every day without missing any pill. On the 5th of this month, I had unprotected sex with my husband, but he did not ejaculate inside me and my second pill pack finished on the 16th this month. Today is my sixth pill-free day, but I still did not get my period. I am not feeling any pre-period symptoms like legs and back pains. I have done a home pregnancy test on the fourth pill-free day, but that was negative.

【9】I am worried about pregnancy because I have a little one who is 2 years old and I do not want another baby now. I had a D and C just four months back as the emergency contraceptive pill Unwanted 72 I took failed in my case. I am worried about this. Please suggest what I should do so that I can relax. Is my sequence of taking the new pill pack of 21 pills after a gap of seven days correct?

【10】Answered by Dr. Sravanthi Nuthalapati

【11】#

【12】Hello,

【13】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【14】As you have correctly taken all the pills in the pack regularly as prescribed, that is for 21 days with 7 days off, there is very less chance of a pregnancy. The failure rates of pills, if properly used, is less than 0.5 %. So, you need not panic and repeat your urine pregnancy test on day-7 of the pill-free days and if negative, restart your fresh pack.

【15】* * *

【16】Patient's Query

【17】Thank you doctor,

【18】I have checked for pregnancy on the fourth pill-free day and that was negative. Is it not an accurate time to detect the pregnancy? Also, are delayed periods normal or a side effect? If not, can I continue taking these pills in the long run?

【19】Answered by Dr. Sravanthi Nuthalapati

【20】#

【21】Hello,

【22】Welcome back to icliniq.com

【23】Usually, the periods should come once you stop the pills. So, just wait till day-7 after stopping the pills and repeat the urine pregnancy test. Get an ultrasound pelvis if you do not get your periods and consult a gynecologist. Delayed periods need not be because of pregnancy.

【24】* * *

source_info.title: I had a knee injury during a sports competition. Please help me treat it.
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. I had a knee injury during a sports competition. Please help me treat it.
============================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Sharoff Lokesh Mohan**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on May 15, 2017 and last reviewed on: Jul 12, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】I am an 18-year-old male. My left shoulder has been having a tingling sensation, which starts when I use the laptop for typing or playing games. I have been having this symptom for more than half a year, this tingling sensation starts when I am just sitting down. It does not hurt, but it is very annoying especially when I am doing my assignments. I had a knee injury when I fell on my right knee during a sports competition. I have not found the reason and solution to the pain but have tried physiotherapy. Currently, my knee aches when the activity is too intense or while doing intense workouts.

【9】Answered by Dr. Sharoff Lokesh Mohan

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】This tingling pain over the shoulder can be due to cervical spine nerve irritation or nowadays it is a new symptom affecting many young people using electrical gadgets. The knee pain can be an **injury to ligaments** or just a condition. I suggest you try doing the following. Ice is useful for the control of pain and swelling. It can be applied to the knee for 15 to 20 minutes as often as every two to four hours. The swollen knee should be elevated above the level of the heart while icing. Activities that cause pain should be avoided temporarily. If the knee is swollen or sore, the following positions and activities should be avoided until knee pain and swelling resolve. Squatting, kneeling, twisting, pivoting, jogging, aerobics, dancing, and playing sports. I suggest you try taking the following medicines. Consult your specialist doctor, discuss with him or her, and start taking the medicines after their consent.

【14】Tablet Pregabalin 75 mg, once daily at night before food for 10 days.

【15】Tablet Etoricoxib 60 mg, twice daily after food for 10 days.

【16】Tablet Rabeprazole 20 mg, twice daily before food for 10 days.

【17】Tablet Shelcal (Calcium carbonate) 500 mg, once in the morning for 30 days.

【18】Tablet Vitamin D (60K), once daily for 10 days, then once a month for 11 months.

【19】Take these tablets only if you are not allergic to them. Do not take these tablets if you are a known case of bronchial asthma. Kindly give more history about the knee pain. This professional advice provided by me stands subject to the actual examination of the report or image and is based entirely on inputs provided to me. It should be correlated with clinical findings.

【20】Thank you.

【21】* * *

【22】* * *

source_info.title: Can white patches appear due to sweating excessively?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Can white patches appear due to sweating excessively?
========================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Syed Muneeb Mohammad**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jul 30, 2022_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】My daughter is a bit chubby compared to other children of her age. She sweats a lot when playing, especially in summer. This has resulted in a white patch appearing on her hands and neck. What should I do to get rid of these patches?

【9】Answered by Dr. Syed Muneeb Mohammad

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】I understand your concern.

【14】It appears to be hyperhidrosis (abnormally excessive sweating). Some children tend to develop a fungal infection due to dampness. Just apply an antifungal cream, especially during the summer. Use Onabet (Sertaconazole) cream and apply it three times a day for five days. Regular exercise is necessary. Please do a thyroid profile test.

【15】* * *

【16】**Investigations to be done:**  

【17】Thyroid profile

source_info.title: What medicines can be taken for severe itching and rash throughout the body?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. What medicines can be taken for severe itching and rash throughout the body?
===============================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Sushil Kakkar**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Dec 03, 2017 and last reviewed on: Jul 13, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I have itching and rash on my arms and legs for one week now. There was no itching before. I went to a dermatologist and got some medicines. However, the rash keeps spreading and since the last Thursday, I have fever constantly of 101 degrees. The rash has spread all over my arms and legs and has now spread to my face and neck. All tests for dengue, malaria, CBC, typhoid have been done. All normal except for low WBC. The medicines are mentioned in the list attached herewith. Doctor's notes are also attached. I cannot sleep because of extreme itching. Please help.

【9】Answered by Dr. Sushil Kakkar

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】I went through the attachments ( _attachment removed to protect patient identity_ ).

【14】You seem to have acute urticaria or acute dermatitis.

【15】I suggest you continue with tablet Mod Pan ( Pantoprazole Sodium Sesquihydrate ) 40 mg empty stomach. However, I would like to add tablet Zempred (Methylprednisolone) 16 mg once a day after breakfast for a week. You may continue with tablet Xevor (Levocetirizine) 5 mg twice a day morning and evening. Topically, you may apply a soothing lotion like calamine lotion frequently. Consult your specialist doctor, discuss with him or her and with their consent take the medicines.

【16】Regards.

【17】Patient's Query

【18】Thank you doctor,

【19】Does urticaria or dermatitis cause high fever? How long do the rashes last? I am concerned because of the rash as it is still spreading after seven days.

【20】Answered by Dr. Sushil Kakkar

【21】#

【22】Hello,

【23】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【24】Urticaria or an acute eruption like this may be due to an underlying cause such as a viral infection or a drug reaction which explains fever.

【25】*   Do you still have a fever? I would like you to upload your lab reports.
*   Do you have any swollen lymph nodes ? or any neck lymph nodes?

【26】Treatment is only symptomatic like topical soothing lotions, oral antihistamines, and Paracetamol for fever. For such widespread eruption, I would rather also give either oral steroids like Zempred (Methylprednisolone) for a week. Consult your specialist doctor, discuss with him or her and with their consent take the medicines. Alternatively, there is an option of using topical steroid cream e.g. Tenovate cream (Clobetasol Topical) or Clop cream (Clobetasol Topical).

【27】Regards.

【28】* * *

source_info.title: I have sudden blurring of vision on one eye. Is it due to retinal detachment?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. I have sudden blurring of vision on one eye. Is it due to retinal detachment?
================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Shikha Gupta**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Apr 03, 2018 and last reviewed on: Jul 09, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】My vision was crystal clear this morning. I just woke up from a nap, and the vision in my left eye is blurry. It has not cleared up in the past half an hour. Twice over the years, this has happened, and it normalized over a few hours, but I am in a jungle now. So, I would like to err on the side of caution. I have had previous retinal detachments. Please help.

【9】Answered by Dr. Shikha Gupta

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Did you get any surgery done for retinal detachment earlier? It may be a recurrent episode of retinal detachment . If you have diabetes or hypertension that may be a cause of this detachment. It can also happen in vitreous hemorrhage in which you will see a slightly reddish vision and will not clear up. If this is the case, then it will clear up in few weeks. What is the exact cause can be told only on examination. You should rush to the emergency asap (as soon as possible). If detachment surgery is required then visual prognosis depends on the time elapsed between episode and surgery. So, you should not delay. There is not much you can do at the moment by yourself. Just seek help from someone to reach a hospital.I hope this helps. Take care.

【14】* * *

source_info.title: What are the ways to treat recurring UTI?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. What are the ways to treat recurring UTI?
============================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Samer Sameer Juma Ali Altawil**

【4】and medically reviewed by Dr. Divya Banu M

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jun 08, 2020 and last reviewed on: Jul 25, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I have recurring UTI. Last time,a few months back, after taking medicines for the recurring UTI, results were normal. I took Cital syrup and antibiotics. After experiencing pain recently I again went for urine test, and it shows RBC, epithelial cells and bacteria. I have attached the reports. I was consulting a gynecologist prior to this, but she told me to consult a urologist. I have attached my last ultrasound and kidney function test along with today's urine test.

【9】Answered by Dr. Samer Sameer Juma Ali Altawil

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】After reviewing your complains and your blood and urine test with ultrasound reports ( _attachment removed to protect patient identity_ ), kidney functions are normal, your ultrasound is normal, your urine analysis showed pus cells and few red cells and white blood cells. My question is do you have symptoms like difficulty in passing urine? Or pain while passing urine? If not then did you have urine culture result before your antibiotics treatment? If you have documented UTI before and you got treated then you have pus cells and white cells in urine, your test might have been performed soon after antibiotics. The possibilities are incomplete treatment or chronic inflammation of the urinary bladder as sending infections are also common in postmenopausal period. You will need to follow up with urine culture test, if it is negative and you have no symptoms then no need to treat. If it is negative and you are still having symptoms (pain while passing urine), we need to do more tests. I hope to follow up you after urine culture results. As preventive measure, you need proper hydration, cranberry juice, yogurt and proper hygiene.

【14】* * *

【15】**The Probable causes:**  

【16】Cystitis, incomplete treatment.

【17】**Investigations to be done:**  

【18】Urine culture.

【19】**Differential diagnosis:**  

【20】Cystitis bacterial, TB.

【21】**Probable diagnosis:**  

【22】Cystitis.

【23】**Treatment plan:**  

【24】Observation and hydration.

【25】**Preventive measures:**  

【26】Hydration cranberry juice, yogurt.

【27】**Regarding follow up:**  

【28】4 days after urine culture.

【29】Patient's Query

【30】Hi doctor,

【31】I have no difficulty or pain in passing urine. Yes, my earlier treatment was done after culture test. Actually, all this started when I visited gynecologist after lower back pain. She gave me suppository, and after taking it postmenopausal bleeding occurred. So I tested for uterine and cervical cancer, both the tests were negative. I was then treated for UTI after urine culture and blood culture showed bacteria. After 5 days of treatment, blood culture was sterile but urine still showed bacteria, so I was treated with Augmentin-375 for 40 days. After this, I recovered. Now after one month, I again experienced these symptoms like lower back pain, burning sensation and bloating. Also, I mistakenly consumed wheat which was a few days past expiry date. I am attaching my culture test as per your instruction and also the routine test I again went for today. Currently, my temperature is between 98-99 degrees F. I am feeling heat throughout my body especially feet. I also have slight headache. Please provide mild medicines as I am a bit sensitive towards medicines. I also want to tell that Ciplox does not suit me.

【32】Answered by Dr. Samer Sameer Juma Ali Altawil

【33】#

【34】Hi,

【35】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【36】Thank you very much for updating me the test results. Your current urine culture is negative but you still have pus cells and bacteria in your urine. We call it sterile pyuria which can be due to stones, foreign body radiation or TB in urine. You do not have history of radiotherapy and your ultrasound last time was normal so you will need urine test for TB (urine test) and x-ray of chest furthermore you will need uroflow post void bladder scan to make sure you can empty completely your bladder. At this time observe your temperature and no need to take antibiotics. If you have fever above 99, then you will need admission otherwise just to do urine for TB and bladder scan. Further work up will be if your urine is negative for TB and chest x-ray in addition to bladder scan. I recommend you to have flexible cystoscope and bladder biopsy. I hope you will get well. Please update me your further investigation so we can proceed towards your treatment better.

【37】* * *

【38】**Investigations to be done:**  

【39】Chest x-ray, urine for AFB culture/PCR, uroflow and bladder scan.

【40】**Differential diagnosis:**  

【41】Cystitis.  
TB cystitis.

【42】**Treatment plan:**  

【43】Paracetamol 1 gm tds in case of fever and admission.

【44】Patient's Query

【45】Hi doctor,

【46】Please look at all the pages of the file I sent you, the culture report is positive. I am sending it again.

【47】Answered by Dr. Samer Sameer Juma Ali Altawil

【48】#

【49】Hi,

【50】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【51】Thank you again for consulting me. The report you sent is urine analysis which I saw already have pus cells and white cells. But the culture if you read down below shows no bacterial growth so urine is sterile and negative. For better explanation please do a video call so I can explain you more clearly. The plan for follow up is as I mentioned above.

【52】Patient's Query

【53】Sir here are the urine reports, both urine culture and routine. I could not go for the bladder scan due to my city being COVID-19 red zone.

【54】Answered by Dr. Samer Sameer Juma Ali Altawil

【55】\# Hi and thank you for following up  
That’s great no more infection  
There is 2-3 pus cells in urine analysis which is normal  
Please keep you hydration of 2-3 liters daily  
Take cranberry juice once glass daily and Yougort as u can.  
Cleaning after passing urine will be from front to back with clean tissue.  
Hopefully you will not have UTI again.  
You should only do urine culture if you have symptoms again otherwise no need.  
Please don’t hesitate to ask for any further questions

【56】Patient's Query

【57】I'm fine sir, thanks for asking. I feel acidity & burning sensation in stomach and sometimes arms and feet after eating certain packed foods.

【58】Answered by Dr. Samer Sameer Juma Ali Altawil

【59】\# Hi  
Yes packed food is not healthy I understand it’s difficult to avoid it sometimes but u can drink ginger I mean boiled ginger after cooking it down I believe it’s better than medicine it can heal the stomach well.  
Let me know if problem persists I will prescribe medications for you.  
Kind regards

【60】* * *

source_info.title: I have multiple sclerosis. Can I get artificial valve for urinary incontinence?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. I have multiple sclerosis. Can I get artificial valve for urinary incontinence?
==================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Raja Ramesh**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on May 30, 2017 and last reviewed on: Jun 28, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】I have secondary progressive multiple sclerosis. I am a 37 year old male. My weight is 165 pounds and height is 6 feet. My neurologist is treating my MS with two rounds of Rituximab infusions (low dose chemotherapy) every six months and a twice-daily dose of an Ampyra capsule. I also take Cymbalta (for depression), Ropinirole (for restless leg syndrome), Magnesium, and Vitamin D. I suffer from urinary incontinence. I have to use a catheter to urinate, and lately, I have been getting blood in my urine and on the catheter after I remove it. My question involves possible treatments for this. I have frequent UTIs and trying to come up with a way to stop this cycle. Is there any artificial valve that can be surgically placed in the urethra to control when my bladder releases consciously? I read something about a surgical valve replacement used in prostate cancer patients who have had their prostate removed. A control for this valve is placed in the scrotum, and the device apparently replaces the natural valve. I am curious if this surgery could be adapted to treat my incontinence.

【9】Answered by Dr. Raja Ramesh

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Multiple sclerosis is a progressive disease. So with time, incontinence may change in either direction, positively or negatively. The best option is what you have been doing. It is called CIC (clean intermittent catheterization). It is adaptable to all stages of disease progression. Artificial urinary sphincter is ideally indicated only in the stable disease like post-prostatectomy incontinence where there will be no progression after two to three years. So, I would not recommend it for multiple sclerosis . Regarding urinary infection, it is bound to occur in anyone on CIC. It needs treatment only when you have symptoms like pain, hematuria, frequency, dysuria, etc. Antibiotics based on the urine culture needs to be given. Once you are asymptomatic, then daily low dose prophylactic antibiotic can prevent repeated infection.

【14】* * *

source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. There is prominent column of Bertin in kidney with abdominal pain. Why?
==========================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Tarek Algamal**

【4】and medically reviewed by Dr. Divya Banu M

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Aug 22, 2019 and last reviewed on: Jul 17, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I have abdominal pain, USG shows prominent column of Bertin noted at left kidney.

【9】Answered by Dr. Tarek Algamal

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】I want to reassure you that this finding is not significant and most likely not related to your abdominal pain. Further assessment including detailed history and proper examination should be done to diagnose the possible reason.

【14】Patient's Query

【15】Thank you doctor,

【16】Prominent column of Bertin noted, what does it mean? Do I need some medicine for that?

【17】Answered by Dr. Tarek Algamal

【18】#

【19】Hi,

【20】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【21】It is a structure in the kidney which is normally present. Being prominent is not serious at all and you do not need treatment for it. It is just mentioned because sometimes it is mistaken as a renal mass. So the radiologist should mention it not to be mistaken by other doctors.

source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Can protected oral sex transmit HIV or STD?
==============================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Kiran Anaparthi**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Sep 10, 2018_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I had a protected oral sex with transgender yesterday. Before we started the oral sex, she showed me her STD (Sexually Transmitted Diseases) and HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus) test results and they were negative (I have doubts about the results as it was sent to here by SMS and there was no date on it). At the start of the oral sex, I sucked her cock with a condom (she was wearing a condom) and then she sucked my cock and I was wearing a condom as well. There was no pre-cum, no cums, no transmission of body fluid, nothing, just the scenario above. I have a simple blood clot in the sublingual salivary glands for the past six months and I am still taking medicine for it. Is there any chance to get STDs or HIV based on the scenario above? I need a direct answer to my situation and no general information, please.

【9】Answered by Dr. Kiran Anaparthi

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】To be clear, HIV will not transmit through oral sex. No possibility for HIV infection. Coming to STDs, there is no transmission of STDs through a protected act. So, there is no possibility for STDs also (including syphilis, chlamydia, gonorrhoea, herpes). Finally, no chances of transmission of either STDs and HIV.

【14】Patient's Query

【15】Hi doctor,

【16】Thank you for response.

【17】I read on some website that it is possible for HIV to transmit through oral sex. But it has low or no risk. And the protected oral sex have even lower risk than unprotected oral sex. My question is whether there is any risk to get HIV in my situation. Or there is no need to worry and I can relax. Just to make sure that I have no HIV or STDs. Please read my situation carefully.

【18】Answered by Dr. Kiran Anaparthi

【19】#

【20】Hi,

【21】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【22】First, answer to your question, there is no risk of HIV infection, nothing to worry because HIV has envelope made of fat, which is digested by saliva and makes it harmless. But the risk attributed by oral sex in some cases due to any ulcer in the oral cavity or on the penis. In your case, condom protects from any possible entry. So, not at risk of HIV.

【23】* * *

source_info.title: Is it possible to do all physical activity after the ASD device closure procedure?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Is it possible to do all physical activity after the ASD device closure procedure?
=====================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Muhammad Zohaib Siddiq**

【4】and medically reviewed by Dr. K Shobana

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jun 15, 2022 and last reviewed on: Jul 25, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】I got ASD device closure, but I have some questions: Can I do all activities like a normal person? Are there any special activities to avoid in my life after this? Can I do the gym? Please guide.

【9】Answered by Dr. Muhammad Zohaib Siddiq

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Yes, it can be done generally, but for individual patients, some other things are also to be assessed, such as LV (left ventricle) and RV (right ventricle) function, residual shunt, pulmonary pressures, etc., on echocardiography. Please send a post-procedural echocardiography report so that I can guide you accordingly. Moreover, your ECG (electrocardiogram) shows premature beats _(attachments removed to protect the patient's identity)_ . The cause should be looked at. Regards.

【14】Patient's Query

【15】Hi doctor,

【16】Thanks for the reply. I am attaching the report here. Thank you.

【17】Answered by Dr. Muhammad Zohaib Siddiq

【18】#

【19】Hi,

【20】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【21】Your device is successfully implanted; there is no residual shunt. You can do normal routine activities and go to the gym after two weeks of implantation. Regards.

【22】* * *

source_info.title: What can cause tingling sensation in muscles?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. What can cause tingling sensation in muscles?
================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Sharoff Lokesh Mohan**

【4】and medically reviewed by Dr. Sneha Kannan

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Feb 01, 2016 and last reviewed on: Jul 25, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】Over the last few months, I am experiencing some tingling kind of sensation in muscles in a specific area below the left breast near the rib. I would like to know what it is and the cause of it. I am having that sensation mostly in the evening.

【9】Answered by Dr. Sharoff Lokesh Mohan

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】This tingling sensation can be due to transient nerve compression. This nerve compression can be due to a muscle spasm or due to abnormalities in the thoracic spine. You should improve your posture and avoid sitting for long hours . Avoid bending your back to lift heavy weights. Apply Voltaren gel (Diclofenac) over the area twice daily. Keep hot fomentation twice daily. Do McKenzie back extension exercises twice daily. It will surely help you.If back pain still persists, then get back to me as you will require a prescription for medication.

【14】Thank you.

【15】* * *

source_info.title: Can I have my next vertigo attack while I drive?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Can I have my next vertigo attack while I drive?
===================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Mehak Agarwal**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Dec 28, 2017 and last reviewed on: Jul 12, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】Two months ago, I experienced a vertigo attack. I went to the doctor. They did all the exams. Blood work was good and CAT scan came back good. The ENT doctor said it is BPPV. He did the head movements for me. I am feeling much better. My question is I cannot be at peace because I have a fear that it might happen to me while I drive. Is this normal? Also, can it happen to me while I drive? I am always uptight.

【9】Answered by Dr. Mehak Agarwal

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Vertigo can happen during driving. So, the patient is asked not to drive for 15 days or so till the symptoms subside. Repeated episodes of vertigo can occur in BPPV (benign paroxysmal positional vertigo). So, whenever you have vertigo, you should be on complete bed rest, take the prescribed medicines, avoid jerky head movements, avoid driving, and have a salt-restricted diet.

【14】* * *

【1】Q. Can I have my next vertigo attack while I drive?
===================================================

<mark>【2】Answered by

【3】Dr. Mehak Agarwal

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】This is a premium question & answer published on Dec 28, 2017 and last reviewed on: Jul 12, 2023

【6】Patient’s Query</mark>nt's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】Two months ago, I experienced a vertigo attack. I went to the doctor. They did all the exams. Blood work was good and CAT scan came back good. The ENT doctor said it is BPPV. He did the head movements for me. I am feeling much better. My question is I cannot be at peace because I have a fear that it might happen to me while I drive. Is this normal? Also, can it happen to me while I drive? I am always uptight.

【9】Answered by Dr. Mehak Agarwal

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Vertigo can happen during driving. So, the patient is asked not to drive for 15 days or so till the symptoms subside. Repeated episodes of vertigo can occur in BPPV (benign paroxysmal positional vertigo). So, whenever you have vertigo, you should be on complete bed rest, take the prescribed medicines, avoid jerky head movements, avoid driving, and have a salt-restricted diet.

【14】* * *

source_info.title: Is Unwanted-72 effective when taken an hour after unprotected sex?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Is Unwanted-72 effective when taken an hour after unprotected sex?
=====================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Shubhadeep Bhattacharjee**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Jun 05, 2018 and last reviewed on: Jul 19, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】My wife had Unwanted-72 an hour after unprotected sex. Would it protect her from an unwanted pregnancy?

【9】Answered by Dr. Shubhadeep Bhattacharjee

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Even the emergency pills like Unwanted-72 carry a failure rate of 1 %. So, please ensure she **take a urine pregnancy test** if she misses a period.

【14】Patient's Query

【15】Thank you doctor,

【16】Surely we will get this done. But, my question is, **is this pill as effective from the first hour** ?  Because, I have heard that the best time to take this pill (Unwanted-72) is between 24 hours and 72 hours after sex. Appreciate your quick reply.

【17】Answered by Dr. Shubhadeep Bhattacharjee

【18】#

【19】Hello,

【20】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【21】*   The mechanism of action of the emergency contraceptive pills like Unwanted-72 or I-pill is by **interfering with the implantation process** . So, even if you have taken it within one hour or anytime within 72 hours, its efficacy remains the same. It can be taken up to 72 hours of unprotected intercourse as sperms may remain alive until then.

【22】For more information consult an **obstetrician and gynaecologist online** \--> https://icliniq.com./ask-a-doctor-online/obstetrician-and-gynaecologist

【23】* * *

source_info.title: What is the cause of severe prickling pain in the underarms, and chest area that radiates to knees?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. What is the cause of severe prickling pain in the underarms, and chest area that radiates to knees?
======================================================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Anshul Varshney**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Feb 20, 2023 and last reviewed on: Jul 21, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】I have severe pricking pain in both my underarms and chest area. Sometimes, pain shoots to both knees. Swollen lymph nodes were seen in the neck region on the CT scan. There is joint pain in the elbows and knees. Pain also radiates from the back to the front of the right breast. What could it be?

【9】Please help.

【10】Answered by Dr. Anshul Varshney

【11】#

【12】Hello,

【13】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【14】I went through your query and understood your concern. It seems you have fibromyalgia or nerve pain. I also went through your reports ( _attachments removed to protect the patient's identity_ ). So I suggest you the following.

【15】1\. Take a vitamin D supplement.

【16】2\. For the pain, I suggest you take a tablet of Duloxetine (selective serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor) and a combination of Pregabalin (anticonvulsant) and Nortriptyline (tricyclic antidepressant) for three months.

【17】3\. Lymph nodes are not significant.

【18】Kindly consult a specialist doctor, talk with them, and take medicines with their consent. I hope this helps you.

【19】Thank you.

【20】Patient's Query

【21】Hello doctor,

【22】Thank you for your reply. What is your opinion on elevated serum protein levels like beta-2 globulin? Can they be related to bone cancer or lymphoma? Please help.

【23】Answered by Dr. Anshul Varshney

【24】#

【25】Hello,

【26】Welcome back to icliniq.com.

【27】Elevated serum beta-2 globulins are usually seen in plasma cell dyscrasias. However, it is not a prevalent form of cancer. However, I suggest you need not worry. Repeat the test. Take the medicines as prescribed and see if there is any improvement. Kindly consult a specialist, talk with them, and take medicines with their consent. I hope this helps you.

【28】Thank you.

【29】* * *

source_info.title: Why BP and sugar levels not reduced despite taking medicines?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Why BP and sugar levels not reduced despite taking medicines?
================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Ankush Dhaniram Gupta**

【4】and medically reviewed by Dr. K Shobana

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Dec 28, 2019 and last reviewed on: Jul 12, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hello doctor,

【8】My mother is 55 years old. She is suffering from diabetes and high BP. Her BP remains 140/90 mmHg. She is taking the following medicines. In the morning Telmisat 40 one tablet, Thyox 25 mg one tablet. During lunchtime Jalra 50 mg one tablet before food, Zoryl M2 Forte one tablet during food. During dinner time Jalra 50 mg one tablet before food, Zoryl M2 Forte one tablet during food, Avas 10 one tablet, Telmisat 40 one tablet, Metolar50 one tablet. The recent lab report shows fasting Glucose -137 mg/dl and Post prandial Glucose- 189 mg/dl. Urine report shows albumin- 184 g/dl, Creatinine- 0.22 mg/dL, Albumin to CR- 836.4 mg/gm, Micral test-184 mg/d. Urine analysis shows: Protein (albumin)- present(+++), Cystatin C.serum 1.51 mg/dL. More details about the presenting complaint: She is suffering from high blood pressure and diabetics. Despite taking medicines diabetics is not lowering. Also sometimes swelling appears in the legs.

【9】Answered by Dr. Ankush Dhaniram Gupta

【10】#

【11】Hello,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com.

【13】Your mother as you said is hypertensive and diabetic. She is on Glimepiride, Vildagliptin antidiabetics and Atorvastatin, Metoprolol as statin and antihypertensive. Her BP (blood pressure) is in under control as per her age and blood sugar is raised moderately. I would advise to start her on insulin. The dose is calculated depending on her weight and blood sugar level. If she is not fine with insulin I would advise to increase the dose of antidiabetic drugs after consulting your family physician. Her kidneys and eyes are fine. Please take care of her feet by doing a regular examination of feet. Increase her daily activity by daily walks and avoid lifts. Diet should be strict. Avoid non-vegetarian rice and fried foods.

【14】* * *

source_info.title: Do I need to worry about panic attacks and irregular heartbeats?
source_info.text:
【0】Listen

【1】Q. Do I need to worry about panic attacks and irregular heartbeats?
===================================================================

【2】Answered by

【3】**Dr. Aditi Gupta**

【4】and medically reviewed by iCliniq medical review team.

【5】_This is a **premium question & answer** published on Aug 26, 2016 and last reviewed on: Jul 26, 2023_

【6】Patient's Query

【7】Hi doctor,

【8】I feel as if I am getting irregular heartbeats. I had suffered from panic attacks quite a few times in the last six months. Since then, I have been having these irregular heartbeats. Although, I have not had a panic attack now, the heart still beats irregularly and it occurs throughout the day. Do I need to worry?

【9】Answered by Dr. Aditi Gupta

【10】#

【11】Hi,

【12】Welcome to icliniq.com. If you haven't undergone any tests yet, it is crucial to take proactive steps in that direction. I recommend getting an ECG, a 2D echocardiogram, and a blood pressure check to assess your cardiovascular health. If you suspect it may be a panic attack , it is essential to be mindful of situations that may trigger it and try to avoid them. During such episodes, rest and relaxation can be helpful. However, before addressing anxiety, I strongly advise visiting a cardiologist to rule out any potential cardiac issues. Once cardiac concerns are ruled out, appropriate treatment for anxiety can be discussed, which may include medications for managing panic attacks. Take care of yourself, and I hope you recover soon.

【13】Patient's Query

【14】Thank you doctor,

【15】I had gone to a psychologist who did say that these were panic attacks. Also, my mother has been getting palpitations almost all her life. She had it checked, but nothing came out abnormal. Do you think this can be hereditary? I do not have any other symptoms. It usually starts in the morning when I go to work and gradually subsides by evening. I get proper sleep and I am eating fine. Can this be something serious? Also, this has started before a few months and I never had experienced it before.

【16】Answered by Dr. Aditi Gupta

【17】#

【18】Hi,

【19】Welcome back to icliniq.com. I reiterate my previous response; it is essential to consult with a cardiologist rather than a psychologist to evaluate your condition thoroughly. Until a cardiac cause is ruled out, it is premature to conclude whether your symptoms are related to panic attacks or anxiety. Neglecting these symptoms could have severe implications for your health. It is important to consider that this condition might have a hereditary component, but regardless, it necessitates proper medical treatment and evaluation by a cardiologist to ensure your well-being.

【20】* * *
